dc-type.scope_note: Categorization: Civil, Criminal, or Cassation. (የመዝገብ ዓይነት፡ ፍትሐብሔር፣ ወንጀል ወይም ሰበር) [cite: 13, 14, 15, 16]
The primary identification number (e.g., ሰ.መ.ቁ. 12345). (ዋና የመዝገብ ቁጥር) [cite: 25]
Initial application or petition number. (የአቤቱታ/የክስ ቁጥር)
The party initiating the legal action. (ከሳሽ ወይም አመልካች) [cite: 57, 73]
The party against whom the action is brought. (ተከሳሽ ወይም መልስ ሰጪ) [cite: 57, 74]
Legal counsel or authorized agent. (የሕግ ወኪል ወይም ጠበቃ) [cite: 40]
Date the file was opened at the Registrar. (መዝገቡ የተከፈተበት ቀን) [cite: 19]
Workflow stage: Registrar, Screening, Litigation, or Archive. (የመዝገቡ የሥራ ሂደት ደረጃ) [cite: 18, 19, 20, 21, 22]
Current judicial state (e.g., Active, Closed). (የመዝገቡ ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ) [cite: 35, 69]
The presiding judge in the bench. (ሰብሳቢ ዳኛ)
Total number of judges (e.g., 3 for Screening, 5 for Cassation). (የዳኞች ብዛት) [cite: 6, 20]
Assigned bench name or courtroom number. (የችሎት ስም ወይም ቁጥር) [cite: 34, 67]
Physical court location or division. (የፍርድ ቤቱ ቦታ/ምድብ)
Physical File, E-File, or Hybrid. (የፋይል አደረጃጀት ዓይነት) [cite: 51, 52, 53]
Shelf ID for paper files in the archive. (የመደርደሪያ ቁጥር) [cite: 22, 52]
Row/Aisle ID in the archive room. (የረድፍ ቁጥር)
Electronic tracking ID for physical folders. (የራፊድ መለያ ቁጥር)
Sub-folder: Pleadings, Orders, Evidence, or Admin. (የሰነድ ክፍል) [cite: 58, 59, 65, 70, 77]
Specific document title (e.g., Complaint, Minutes). (የሰነዱ ዓይነት) [cite: 30, 34, 35]
Active or Inactive status for specific documents. (የሰነዱ ሁኔታ)
Evidence ID (e.g., ከ-1 or ተ-1). (የማስረጃ መለያ ኮድ) [cite: 57, 73, 74]
Date the file was checked out. (የወጣበት ቀን)
Record officer handing over the file. (ያስረከበው)
Judge or Prosecutor receiving the file. (የተቀበለው)
Department or Bench the file went to. (የሄደበት ክፍል)
Date the file was returned to the archive. (የተመለሰበት ቀን)
Current state of the checkout: OUT or RETURNED. (የሰነድ ሁኔታ)
